desktop_preview: Samfoti: injin tacewa bai haɗu a wannan kwamfuta ba tukuna. Maɓallin yana nuna yadda manhajar za ta yi aiki ne kawai.
state_on_detail_no_delay: Ana cire kayan kiɗa daga dukkan manhajoji.
engine_error_no_pactl: Ba a sami kayan aikin sauti ba (pactl). Waaiya yana buƙatar PulseAudio, ko PipeWire tare da pipewire-pulse.
engine_error_no_sound_server: Sabar sauti ba ta aiki (PulseAudio ko PipeWire).
engine_error_no_systemd: Wannan tsari ba shi da zaman mai amfani na systemd, wanda ke gudanar da matatar sauti a bayan fage.
engine_error_no_output: Ba a sami lasifika ko belun kunne ba.
engine_error_install_failed:
Ba a iya shigar da matatar sauti ba. Bayani:
{details}
engine_error_start_failed:
Matatar sauti ba ta fara ba. Bayani:
{details}
engine_error_service_failed:
Matatar sauti ta tsaya da kuskure. Bayani:
{details}
autostart_body: Tace sauti da zarar kun shiga kwamfuta.
blur_body_desktop: Yana rufe mutane da hotuna a allo, a saman kowace taga, yayin da Waaiya ke buɗe (yana aiki ko matatar sauti tana kunne ko a kashe). Yana aiki a wannan kwamfuta; ba a tura komai zuwa ko'ina ba. Rufe tagar Waaiya yana dakatar da dusashewa.
blur_fail_body_desktop: A kunne: ana rufe dukkan allo idan kwamfutar ta yi jinkiri sosai ko dusashewa ta kasa; dannawa tana ci gaba da kaiwa tagogin da ke ƙasa. A kashe: allon yana bayyana tare da jan layi a sama.
blur_status_on_visible_desktop: Dusashewa tana kunne. Wannan kwamfuta tana nuna dusashewar a cikin ɗaukar allonta, don haka wurin da aka dusashe zai ci gaba da kasancewa a dusashe har sai abin da ke allo ya canza.
blur_status_no_capture:
Dusashewa ba ta iya ganin allo. Bayani:
{details}
blur_status_no_overlay_desktop:
Dusashewa ba za ta iya nunawa a saman sauran tagogi a wannan kwamfuta ba. Bayani:
{details}
blur_status_share_dialog: Zaɓi allonku a tagar raba allo sannan ku ba da izini. Waaiya yana tambaya sau ɗaya kawai; hoton yana zama a wannan kwamfuta.
blur_status_exited:
Dusashewa ta tsaya ba zato ba tsammani. Ku kashe wani zaɓin dusashewa sannan ku sake kunna shi don sake gwadawa. Bayani:
{details}
engine_detector_failed: Mai gane waƙar mata bai buɗu ba, don haka ana kashe muryoyi yayin da wannan zaɓi ke kunne.
blur_status_uncovered: Akwai allo (monitor) da dusashewa ba ta rufe ba: ba a raba shi da ita ba, ko an haɗa shi daga baya. Ku kashe wani zaɓin dusashewa sannan ku sake kunna shi, kuma ku zaɓi kowane allo a tagar raba allo.
blur_status_models_missing_desktop: Tsarin dusashewa ba su cikin wannan shigarwa, don haka ba za ta iya rufe komai ba; jan layi zai ci gaba da kasancewa a saman allo. Ku sake shigar da Waaiya.
diag_note_desktop: Abin da Waaiya ke gani a wannan kwamfuta. Ku kwafa shi ku ba wanda ke taimaka muku. Manhajar kanta ba ta tura komai.
setting_hold_silence_body_desktop: Ana ba da shawara. Idan tacewa ta tsaya da kanta (kuskure, ba ku ba), sauran manhajoji za su yi shiru har sai kun sake farawa ko kun danna Dakatar, maimakon kunna kiɗa ba tare da tacewa ba.
setting_stereo_body_desktop: A kashe: mono, wanda ke amfani da ƙarfin kwamfuta kaɗan. A kunne: yana raba gefen hagu da na dama. Idan kwamfutar ta yi jinkiri sosai don stereo, za ta koma mono da kanta.
link_entry_body_desktop: Liƙa mahaɗar (link) YouTube, TikTok ko Instagram don kallo da tacewa a kunne, ko don ajiye ta ba tare da kiɗa ba.
link_entry_body_watch: Liƙa mahaɗar (link) YouTube, TikTok ko Instagram don kallo a burauzarku da tacewa a kunne.
link_watch_note_desktop: Yana buɗewa a burauzarku. Waaiya yana fara kunna tacewa, don haka ana cire kiɗan a can ma.
link_filter_failed: Tacewa ba ta fara ba, don haka ba a buɗe mahaɗar ba. Ku kunna ta a shafin Tacewa sannan ku sake gwadawa.
link_saved_video_desktop: A babban fayil ɗin bidiyo “Videos”: Waaiya
link_saved_audio_desktop: A babban fayil ɗin sauti “Music”: Waaiya
link_singing_note: Ana kashe waƙar mata ma, kamar yadda yake a saitunanku.
singing_keep_body: Ana cire kayan kiɗa amma ana barin muryoyin waƙa, don haka lacca mai nashidi a ƙarƙashinta za ta riƙe muryar nashidin ma; ko hakan ya dace, zaɓinku ne.
singing_keep_no_model: Wannan sigar ba ta da tsarin waƙa, don haka sautin yana yin shiru yayin da wannan ke kunne. Ku kashe shi.
fix_filter_apps_title: Manhajojin da ake ji ba tare da tacewa ba
fix_filter_apps_body: Manhajojin da kuka zaɓa a nan suna kunna sautinsu yadda yake: babu tacewa, babu shiru. Misali, manhajar kiran bidiyo, don kada kira ya yi jinkiri.
fix_no_apps: Ba a zaɓi wata manhaja ba.
fix_pick_empty: Ba a sami wata manhaja ba.
fix_pick_playing_desktop: Manhajojin da ke kunna sauti yanzu, da waɗanda aka riga aka zaɓa.
fix_blur_apps_title: Manhajojin da ba a rufe ba
fix_blur_apps_body: Babu murfi yayin da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan manhajoji ta cika allo, misali manhajar taswira ko manhajar bankinku. Murfin suna dawowa da zarar kun bar ta, ko duk lokacin da Waaiya bai tabbata wace manhaja ake nunawa ba.
fix_blur_apps_needs_setup: Yana buƙatar saitin sau ɗaya: ba tare da shi ba Waaiya ba zai iya gane wace manhaja ke kan allo ba, don haka dusashewa tana ci gaba a ko'ina.
fix_blur_apps_helper_mode: Mataimakin Waaiya ba ya aiki, don haka ba za a iya karanta manhajar da ke kan allo ba. Dusashewa tana ci gaba a ko'ina har sai an sake kunna mataimakin daga shafin Saiti.
fix_hand_body: Yayin da dusashewa ke aiki, za ku iya rufe wani ɓangare na allo da kanku, misali hoton da dusashewa ta tsallake: ku danna “Rufe wani wuri” sannan ku ja yatsanku a kansa. Zai kasance a rufe har sai kun cire shi ko dusashewa ta tsaya.
fix_hand_not_running: Ana samu yayin da dusashewa ke aiki: tacewa a kunne kuma wani zaɓin dusashewa a kunne.
fix_note_body: Idan Waaiya ya yi kuskure, ku danna abin da ya faru, misali “Kiɗa ya wuce”. Bayanin yana adana lokacin, manhajar da saitunan, don taimakawa a gano dalilin. Yana zama a wannan na'ura kuma ba a taɓa aika shi ba.
fix_missed_screen: Ba a rufe wani abu ba
fix_notes_delete_ask: A share dukkan bayanan? Ba za a iya dawo da su ba.
worship_body: Na zaɓi ne. Ana lissafa su a wannan waya daga wurin da kuka zaɓa. Ba a aika komai.
worship_place_no_match: Ba a sami birni ba. Kuna iya shigar da lambobin wuri (latitude da longitude) maimakon haka.
worship_custom_invalid: Ku duba lambobin da yankin lokacin.
worship_place_invalid: Ba za a iya amfani da wannan wurin ba. Ku sake zaɓar sa.
worship_method_note: An zaɓa daga ƙasar birnin. Ku zaɓi wadda masallacinku ke bi.
worship_asr_standard: Na yau da kullum (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali)
worship_method_mwl: Ƙungiyar Musulmi ta Duniya (Muslim World League)
worship_no_times: Babu lokutan salla a nan yau: rana ba ta fitowa ko ba ta faɗuwa.
worship_silent_body: A kowane lokacin salla wayar tana yin shiru (“Do Not Disturb”) na mintunan da ke ƙasa, sannan ta koma yadda take. Misali, daga Azahar ƙarfe 12:00 zuwa 12:20.
worship_mute_title: Kashe sautin media a lokacin kiran salla
worship_mute_body: A kowane lokacin salla, ana kashe sautin media (bidiyo, kiɗa, wasanni) na mintunan da ke ƙasa. Sanarwar za ta iya dawo da sautin nan take.
worship_dnd_needed: Ku ba Waaiya izinin canza “Do Not Disturb”, in ba haka ba wayar ba za ta iya yin shiru ba.
worship_exact_needed: Ba a ba Waaiya izinin ƙararrawa da tunatarwa ba, don haka kowane canji zai iya jinkiri har minti 10, ko fiye yayin da wayar ke barci.
worship_notifications_needed: Sanarwa a kashe take: ba za ku ga lokacin da wayar ta yi shiru ko ta dawo ba.
worship_tones_title: Sautin kira da na sanarwa marasa kiɗa
worship_tones_body: Waaiya ba zai iya tace sautin kira ko na sanarwa ba, sai dai ya maye gurbinsu. Zaɓi sauti mara kiɗa:
worship_tone_permission: Ku ba Waaiya izinin gyara saitunan tsarin, ku dawo, sannan ku sake taɓawa.
worship_tone_failed: Wannan waya ba ta bar Waaiya ya canza shi ba. A saitunan Sauti (Sound), zaɓi sautin mai suna “Waaiya plain”.
worship_sms_title: Amsa kira ta SMS lokacin salla
worship_sms_body: A mintunan shiru bayan kowane lokacin salla, kiran da aka bar shi yana ƙara yana samun SMS ɗaya. Sau ɗaya ga kowace lamba a kowace salla; ba a taɓa aikawa zuwa ɓoyayyun lambobi ko gajerun lambobi ba.
worship_sms_cost: Kowace amsa SMS ce ta yau da kullum daga SIM ɗinku, a farashin tsarinku. Ba a aika komai yayin yawo (roaming).
worship_sms_roaming: Ana yawo (roaming) yanzu: ba a aika SMS.
worship_sms_log_title: Amsoshin da aka aika (ana adana su a wannan waya kawai)
worship_why_dnd: Don wayar ta yi shiru a lokutan salla, ku ba Waaiya damar “Do Not Disturb” a shafi na gaba.
worship_why_exact: Don yin aiki daidai a kan lokaci, ku ba Waaiya izinin saita ƙararrawa da tunatarwa a shafi na gaba. Ba tare da shi ba, canje-canje za su iya jinkiri har minti 10.
worship_why_notifications: Ku ba da izinin sanarwa don ku ga kowane canji kuma ku iya soke shi.
worship_why_write: Don canza sautin kira ko na sanarwa, ku ba Waaiya izinin gyara saitunan tsarin a shafi na gaba.
worship_why_phone: Don sanin cewa kira yana ƙara da lambarsa, Waaiya yana buƙatar izinin Waya (Phone) da Bayanan kira (Call logs). Babu abin da ke barin wayar sai amsarku.
worship_why_sms: Don aika amsarku, Waaiya yana buƙatar izinin aika SMS. Yana aika wannan amsar kawai, ba fiye da sau ɗaya ga kowace lamba a kowace salla ba.
worship_missing_dnd: Ba a ba da damar “Do Not Disturb” ba, don haka shirun yana nan a kashe.
worship_missing_phone: Ba a ba da izinin Waya da Bayanan kira ba, don haka amsar SMS tana nan a kashe.
worship_missing_sms: Ba a ba da izinin aika SMS ba, don haka amsar SMS tana nan a kashe.
protect_body: Don lokacin rauni da za ku so kashe tacewa. Ku zaɓi lokacin jira yanzu, cikin natsuwa: sai maɓallin tsayawa ba zai dakatar da tacewa nan take ba, kuma za ku sake yanke shawara idan lokacin ya ƙare. Iyaye ma za su iya saka PIN.
protect_delay_body: Misali, da minti 30: kuna danna maɓallin tsayawa, amma tacewa tana ci gaba da aiki. Bayan minti 30, wannan shafi zai tambaye ku ko har yanzu kuna son dakatarwa. Ku danna “Tabbatar” cikin minti 15 sai ta tsaya; in ba haka ba babu abin da zai canza. Haka nan ma kashe murfi ko wata kariya. Kunna abubuwa koyaushe yana aiki nan take.
protect_pin_body: Da PIN, dakatar da tacewa ko kashe kowace kariya yana neman PIN da farko. Misali, iyaye suna saka PIN don kada yaro ya iya kashe tacewa. Canza lokacin jira ko PIN ma yana neman sa.
protect_pin_forgot: Ku rubuta PIN a wuri mai aminci: idan an manta shi, babu hanyar sake saita shi. Hanya ɗaya kawai ita ce a share bayanan Waaiya ko a sake shigar da shi, wanda kuma ke share dukkan saitunansa.
protect_pin_differ: Sababbin PIN ɗin biyu ba ɗaya suke ba.
protect_pin_wrong: PIN ba daidai ba ne. Sauran gwaji {count} kafin a ɗan dakata.
protect_locked: Kuskure ya yi yawa. Sake gwadawa a {time}.
protect_pending: {what}: ana jira har {time}. Sannan ku tabbatar a “Saituna”.
protect_ready: {what}: jira ya ƙare. Har yanzu kuna so? Ku danna “Tabbatar” kafin {time}; in ba haka ba babu abin da zai canza.
protect_wait_body: {what} ba zai faru yanzu ba. A {time}, idan har yanzu kuna so, ku tabbatar a “Saituna” cikin minti 15. Idan ba ku yi komai ba, babu abin da zai canza.
protect_started: Ana jira har {time}. Sannan ku tabbatar a “Saituna”.
protect_held_back: Ba yanzu ba: saitunan kariyarku suna sa wannan canjin ya jira, ko kuma suna neman PIN.
protect_limits: Abin da wannan ba zai iya hanawa ba: tilasta tsayawa (force stop), cire manhajar, share bayanan Waaiya da saitunan Android na kansa. Hana waɗannan zai buƙaci izini na musamman na Android waɗanda Waaiya ba ya amfani da su. Wannan yana kare ku daga lokacin rauni, ba daga mutumin da ya ƙudura ba.
protect_limits_desktop: Abin da wannan ba zai iya hanawa ba: umarnin waaiya a terminal, cire Waaiya ko share babban fayil ɗin saitunansa. Wannan yana kare ku daga lokacin rauni, ba daga mutumin da ya ƙudura ba.
protect_limits_windows: Abin da wannan ba zai iya hanawa ba: umarnin waaiya-filter.exe a terminal, cire Waaiya ko share babban fayil ɗin saitunansa. Wannan yana kare ku daga lokacin rauni, ba daga mutumin da ya ƙudura ba.
protect_what_gender: Canza wanda ke amfani da Waaiya
onboard_body_desktop: Waaiya yana cire kayan kiɗa daga sautin kowace manhaja a wannan kwamfuta. Ana barin magana da karatun Alƙur'ani. A yanzu, ana cire muryoyin waƙa ma.
worship_why_location: Don gano lokutan sallah a inda kake, Waaiya na karanta kimanin wurin wannan waya sau ɗaya, yanzu. Ana ajiye shi a waya a matsayin wurinka, ba a aika shi ko'ina.
worship_location_denied: Ba a ba da izinin wuri ba. Za ka iya neman garinka maimakon haka.
worship_location_off: An kashe wuri a wannan waya. Kunna shi ka sake gwadawa, ko ka nemi garinka.
worship_location_failed: Ba a sami wurinka ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba, ko ka nemi garinka.
worship_habous_note: Lokutan hukuma na Ma'aikatar Habous da Harkokin Musulunci na {city}.
engine_error_autostart_blocked: Windows ba ya barin Waaiya ta fara lokacin shiga. Kunna Waaiya a Settings › Apps › Startup, sannan ka sake kunna wannan.
engine_error_autostart_policy: Saitunan wannan kwamfuta, waɗanda mai kula da ita ya zaɓa, ba sa barin Waaiya ta fara lokacin shiga.
notif_text_body: Android tana ɓoye abin da sanarwa ke faɗi yayin da wata manhaja ke ɗaukar dukan allo, kuma tacewa tana cikin haka. A kunne: Waaiya tana cire wannan kariya ne kawai yayin tacewa, don ka karanta sanarwarka. Sauran raba allo a lokaci guda ma ba za su sami kariya ba.
notif_text_next_start: Dakatar da tacewa ka sake farawa domin wannan canji ya yi aiki.
notif_text_refused: Wannan waya ta ƙi canjin. Kunna “Kashe kariyar raba allo” da kanka a cikin Zaɓuɓɓukan masu haɓakawa.
notif_text_by_hand: Ana nunawa: kariyar Android a kashe take a cikin Zaɓuɓɓukan masu haɓakawa (“Kashe kariyar raba allo”). Za ta kasance a kashe ga kowane raba allo har sai ka sake kunna ta a can.
notif_text_how_to: Android tana ɓoye abin da sanarwa ke faɗi yayin da Waaiya ke tacewa. Bayan saitin sau ɗaya, Waaiya tana nuna su: tana cire wannan kariya yayin tacewa kawai.
notif_text_lock_note: A wannan waya Android tana dakatar da tacewa idan an kulle allo, sauran manhajoji kuma su yi shiru har sai ka taɓa Ci gaba. Saitin yana hana hakan ma.
notif_text_hand_optional: Na zaɓi, ba tare da saiti ba: kunna “Kashe kariyar raba allo” a cikin Zaɓuɓɓukan masu haɓakawa. Daga nan za ta kasance a kashe ga kowane raba allo, kuma wasu wayoyi ba su da ita.
notif_text_forced: A kunne: a wannan waya Android tana tambaya kafin kowace farawa, kuma da za ta dakatar da tacewa duk lokacin da aka kulle allo. Waaiya tana cire wannan kariya yayin tacewa, don haka rubutun sanarwa ma yana bayyana. Sauran raba allo a lokaci guda ma ba su da kariya.
one_app_title: A farawa: “Raba manhaja ɗaya”, sannan Waaiya
one_app_body: Idan Android ta tambayi abin da za a raba, zaɓi “Raba manhaja ɗaya”, sannan Waaiya. Duk manhajoji za su ci gaba da tacewa, sanarwa za su kasance a karanta, kuma tacewa za ta ci gaba idan an kulle allo. Da dukan allo, Android tana ɓoye rubutun sanarwa kuma tana dakatar da tacewa a kowace kullewa.
one_app_pair: Domin Waaiya ta yi aiki gaba ɗaya, haɗa ta sau ɗaya da Wireless debugging a shafin Saiti: daga nan ana kashe kiɗan asali ma, kuma Android ta daina tambaya a kowace farawa.
notif_text_one_app: Ana nunawa idan ka zaɓi “Raba manhaja ɗaya”, sannan Waaiya, a farawa. Da dukan allo Android tana ɓoye shi; bayan saitin sau ɗaya Waaiya tana cire hakan yayin tacewa.
blur_needs_restart: Dakatar da tacewa ka sake farawa don amfani da dushewa: tana buƙatar dukan allo, kuma wannan tacewa ta fara ne da zaɓin “Raba manhaja ɗaya”.
